_about: Enchanting (Godot build: game/systems/forge.gd), at any npc with `enchanter: true` (an enchanter in any major town). `enchant`: each rank counts as +1 item level, and the item's stats are worked out again by the item budget (docs/stats-and-damage.md). `caps` by rarity: how many ranks an item can take. `ranks` (one entry a rank, in order): coins, plus a count of each material named in `bands` (the first band whose `upToLevel` is at least the item's level before the rank), plus `coinsPerItemLevel` x level coins on top. An epic or legendary item's last rank (its cap) also needs `lastRank`. `scrap` breaks enhanced gear or better into `dust` of its band (a count by rarity) and `extra` for the rarities listed, gives back `refund` of every enchanting material put into it, and its gems (never metal or leather); the window shows what you get first. An enchanter scraps gear; smiths no longer do. Dust also falls from casters, soulshards from great beasts and bosses (loot_tables.json).
